She found [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GodirLoreConcept]Godirhood[/hyperlink] through a terrifying blood ritual which cost many lives.[br/][br/]The Bloodied Halflings were once a peaceful tribe, but after a terrible earthquake trapped all survivors underground, they had to resort to cannibalism to survive. EN: Edward Portsmith defended the Commonwealth when reality was assaulted by Shadow Demons. He mastered powerful arcane magic to fight a war that turned the shadows away. He inspired men to fight for the common values held by the living. To this day, even as he faces the effects of time and mortality, he stands ready to defend those who will defend an Age of Wonders. [br/][br/]Legends abound as to the origins of humans. The most common story tells that the first men came in ships, driven from a garden, into the rich lands they were promised. Humans frequently tell stories that place themselves as the ones destined to reign. Though they seem unremarkable in comparison to other races, somehow these clever inventors continue to stick around.

Até hoje, mesmo enfrentando os efeitos do tempo e da mortalidade, ele está pronto para defender aqueles que defenderão uma Era de Maravilhas. [br/][br/]Lendas abundam quanto à origem dos humanos. A história mais comum conta que os primeiros homens chegaram em navios, expulsos de um jardim, para as terras férteis que lhes foram prometidas. Humanos frequentemente contam histórias que os colocam como os destinados a reinar. Embora pareçam insignificantes em comparação com outras raças, de alguma forma esses engenhosos inventores continuam por aí.

EN: Rupsta was among the greatest of the Goblin chieftains on {GLOBAL.AthlaLoreConcept.Hyperlink}, notable for his immense stature and the smoke that billowed from the pipe always clamped in his mouth.
